thread:
paul: Quick check-in before we finalize the SOC2-ready provenance workstream. Customer asked for auditable exports that are cryptographically verifiable + retention controls. Need a short design + launch checklist.

mina: We should avoid reinventing per-request signing. Proposal: batch manifests every 10m, produce COSE/PKCS7 signature envelope, and include a verification tool.

taylor: For SOC2 evidence they like immutable snapshots. Two delivery modes: 1) On-demand export (72h SLA) 2) Continuous push to customer's S3/GCS (with object-lock enabled).

sam: Keying: support three modes: BYO-PubKey (customer uploads pubkey), Redwood-signed (we sign, provide attestations), and HSM-backed cross-signed workflows. Need KMS policy mapping.

nora: Legal: we must capture chain metadata: requester identity (org id + token id), model version, route, region, timestamps, redaction flags, and purpose. Also include a custodian contact field in the export manifest.

oliver: Ops note: object-lock retention vs copy-on-write immutable store have different cost and restore semantics. Recommend providing both but default to a time-limited immutable bucket with explicit legal-hold flag.

mina: Example manifest sketch (fields only): ```
{
  "export_window": "2026-05-10T12:00:00Z/2026-05-10T12:10:00Z",
  "export_id": "exp-176543-0001",
  "items": [{"path":"logs/176543/0001.jsonl","sha256":"...","redacted":false}],
  "model_ref": "redwood/rlm-13b@sha256:abcd",
  "requestors": [{"org":"acme","token":"tk-123", "user":"alice@acme.com"}],
  "custodian_contact": "legal@acme.com",
  "signatures": [{"algorithm":"COSE","signed_by":"redwood-infra-v2","signature":"..."}]
}
```

taylor: UX: Console flow: Settings -> Compliance -> Provenance -> Create export. API: POST /v1/compliance/exports with fields: range, delivery_mode, retention, custodian_contact, customer_pubkey(optional).

sam: Security: verify incoming customer_pubkey via KMS fingerprint. When customer wants BYO-sign, we verify their signature on ingest and store their pubkey thumbprint in the manifest. Rotation: include key_id + key_version in manifest.

nora: Launch criteria (MVP):
- export package (logs + manifest + verification script)
- support for at least one BYO-pubkey flow + Redwood-signer flow
- console and API to request exports
- SLA commitments: 72h for on-demand, real-time pushes best-effort (note in contract)
- legal onboarding checklist live

oliver: Infra tasks:
- implement manifest producer service (batch windowing + checksum)
- sign/verify library (COSE / PKCS7) + HSM/KMS hooks
- export builder (streaming tar.gz) + delivery adapters (S3, GCS, download)
- retention enforcement + legal-hold toggle + billing flag

mina: Devex tasks: quickstart repo, verification CLI (go/python), and a short runbook for support. Include sample verification command: ```verify-export --manifest manifest.json --keys redwood.pub.pem```

sam: Threat model highlights: protect signing keys (HSM), mitigate replay by including monotonic export_id + window, timestamp drift checks (ntp/proof), and guard against malicious customer pubkeys (validate cert chain if provided).

nora: Contracts: add legal-hold opt-in during onboarding, include chargeable retention tiers, and define export turnaround SLAs. Also require customer custodian contact and DPA references.

oliver: Cost estimate (back-of-envelope): manifests negligible but storing 90 days immutable for a 500GB/day customer adds ~45TB stored; show billing delta in onboarding UI.

paul: Can eng/security/legal give a quick go/no-go on MVP scope by EOD? If yes we'll author an RFC and a market-facing FAQ for sales.

ops-bot: infra:manifest-producer deployed to staging (build-7890) :white_check_mark:

mina: I'll draft the RFC tonight covering schema, key flows, and minimal API.

taylor: I'll mock the console screens and API contract.

sam: Security will prepare HSM integration plan and key rotation policy.

nora: Legal will produce the onboarding checklist + sample SLA language.

paul: Great. We'll surface this to the sales lead before next week's demos. Thanks. :thumbsup:
